Implemented the fix in `crates/nu-command/src/filesystem/ls.rs`. With `--full-paths`/`-f`, relative symlink targets are now resolved against the symlink's parent directory, so `ls -lf` reports absolute paths in the `target` column. Applied to both the standard and Windows fallback paths.
